label: Savings declared in the declaration filed in early 2023
detail: Index.hr reported that the new declaration raised his declared savings from 170,000 EUR to 250,000 EUR, the increase coming from an inheritance, and listed 461.90 EUR of inheritance and gift tax paid; tportal later described the 250,000 EUR as acquired from employment income and inheritance. Croatian officials file asset declarations (imovinske kartice) with the Commission for the Resolution of Conflicts of Interest, which publishes them in its register of officials on sukobinteresa.hr; the register's individual pages are excluded by the site's robots.txt and could not be read by the harvest, so the figures are taken from established media that reported the published declaration.
